༄༅// bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa lha nyer gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor smin byed gser ldan 'degs pa'i 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs// tshangs chen bka' lung gis phab dag byed rgyun// yongs bzung 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyong brtson pa// skal ldan shing rta ji bzhin 'khor lo'i mgon// sman 'dogs drin mtha' dpag yas gtsug tu mchod// yid srubs thul gyi mchog rnams sems can srog /mthar byed mtshun 'jug rnam par rtog pa'i dgra// bde stong zung 'jug chen po'i dbyings bsgral phyir// gdong drug khro bor sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du// smin byed cho gas slob ma'i sgrib gsum sbyong*// rim gnyis rnal 'byor bsgom par dbang bskur nas// tshul bzhin sgrub la ci 'dod grub pa ster// rnam par grol ba'i snying po'i skal ldan byed// 'on te tshig don rnam par 'khrugs pa'i sgras// mtshan rtog sgrib pa las skyob sngags kyi sgor// 'khrid 'dod spobs pa'i ngo tshar ma bzod pas// rgyal kun byin rlabs dbyings su bros kyis dogs// de phyir rigs mchog gdul bya'i phung po khams// skye mched dad gsum gshin pa'i zhing sa la// rgyu lam dbyar skyes myu gu bskyed bsring phyir// mtshams sbyor sprin gyi bzhad sgra dgod do kye// de'ang 'dir gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug ldan gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang sta gon dngos gzhi'i cho ga sgrub pa'i rim pa rnams mngon par rtogs pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ 'dir slob ma sta gon gyi bshad pa'i mtshams sbyor la/ slob ma nyer lnga tshun bsags pa khrus dang phyag byas te gral du 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod do// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i bstan par 'jug pa'i sgo'am lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa'ang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs dang*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos kyi tshig don la yid mi gtod pa snod kha sbubs lta bu'i skyon dang*/ yid gtad kyang dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis mi 'dzin pa snod zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis bzung yang*/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang*// don du gnyer ba med nyid dang*// phyi rol rnam g.yeng yid bsdus dang*// skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar dri ma drug po gang rung dang ldan pa ni snod dri ma can gyi skyon te snod kyi skyon gsum spangs nas gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas legs par gsan 'tshal/ de la spyir dam pa'i chos kyi nyan bshad sgrub pa thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i bsam pa 'di ltar nges par bya dgos te/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang*/ sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med// de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu me mtshon rgya tsha la sogs reg bskyed bzhin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig za ba dang gsod pa dang bkol spyad kyi sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa dang mi 'dod pa thog tu bab pa'i sdug bsngal/

lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang lus bcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha rnams la 'chi 'pho dang gong ma nas 'og mar ltung ba dang*/ mthar ngan song du skye bar shes nas dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal rnams yod par bshad/ 'o na sdug bsngal de dag las rang nyid gcig pu thar pa'i nyan rang gi byang chub thob par bya dgos pa yin nam snyam na/ nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs shing gzhan don gyi phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung ste bzo nyes pa 'chos dka' ba ltar/ mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du byed pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i snying po ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya yin snyam na/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'das shing*/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'ang rang nyid gcig pu'i don phyir ma yin te byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang rung*// sems can don las gzhan mi spyad// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re re nas kyang rang re rnams kyis pha mar byas shing*/ de dag gi gnas skabs su gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin chen sha stag yin pa la/ 'di rnams 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod kyang de sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis ni ldongs/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang ni bral/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bu bas ni ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam nas brdeg 'chos shing*/ ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar 'grim pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du mos pa mdzod/ snying rje'o tsam byas nas bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral/ bde ba la 'god dgos/ de'i nus pa da ltar bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa 'ga' zhig la'ang med/ su zhig la yod ce na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ste don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir ro// des na sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de thob par byed pa la rgyu rkyen med pa las mi thob pas rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par blangs te/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyi zhing lam la ci nus kyis 'bad pa bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dung pa re bskyed 'tshal/ bsam pa de lta bus kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba ci byas thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung gi tshul gyis 'byung ba yin pas 'di shin tu gal che ba yin no// de lta bu'i blo can rnams la/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can de nyid kyis/ gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal rjes su mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar bsam gyis mi khyab par phye ba rnams phyogs ris su bsdu na/ mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes pa'i don ni/

gdul bya 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong dang*/ zhe sdang la spyod pa'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong dang*/ gti mug la spyod pa'i gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong dang*/ dug gsum cha mnyam la spyod pa'i gnyen por sngags kyi sde snod nyi khri chig stong rnams gsungs pa las 'dir de thams cad kyi rtse mor gyur pa sngags kyi sde snod yin/ de la mkhas shing grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rnams kyis rgyud sde so so'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'grel tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rgyud sde'i rim pa gsum dang bzhi dang lnga dang drug tu 'dod pa'i bar yod de/ de'ang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas// rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes gsum du bsdu ba'ang ting nge 'dzin gtso bor gyur pa tsam la dgongs nas rnal 'byor bla med kyang rnal 'byor rgyud du bsdus pa'o// yang ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas 'phags mchog klu sgrub la sogs pa ni/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de lngar dbye ba'ang*/ rtog pa'i rgyud ni sngags dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pas ngo bo bya ba'i rgyud du 'du ba dang*/ yang kye rdo rje las/ dgod dang lta ba dag gis dang*// 'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis kyis// rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis// dgongs pa'i skad ni ma bsgrags pa// zhes bzhir gsungs pa'i shugs la lnga pa zhes ston pas slob dpon bir+wa pa la sogs pa bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum dang*/ rnal 'byor bla ma dang bla med gnyis te/ lngar dbye ba'ang gnyis ka gsang ba'i ye shes bla na med pa ston pas bla med nyid du bsdus pa'o// bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/

ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba las// sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa// de dang de la dga' ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ slob dpon ka ma la shī la sogs pa ni mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor gsang ba dang*/ gsang mtha'i rgyud de drug tu dbye ba'ang*/ rtog pa'i rgyud ni bya rgyud du 'du ba gong du smos pa ltar dang*/ gsang mtha' ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rjod byed rtog dka' ba tsam la dgongs nas logs su byas pa yin gyi/ don gsang ba'i ye shes bla na med pa las logs su gyur pa yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir 'du ba yin no// des na don la rgyud sde bzhir nges pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag sbyangs pa che 'bring bzhi la dgongs nas rgyud sde bzhir gzhag ste/ gang zag phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba rnams la bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi lus ngag gi spyod pa dang nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod par dga' ba rnams la spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ ting nge 'dzin kho nar gtso bor spyod par dga' ba rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med pa gtso bor spyod par dga' ba rnams la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde bzhir 'gyur ba las/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ de la thabs dang shes rab dang gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum las/ 'dir gtso bo thabs kyi rgyud yin/ de la'ang dpa' bo zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud rnams gsum zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rnams gsungs/

gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud rnams gsungs pa las/ 'dir gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud de/ de la'ang nang gsel gyi dbye ba dmar nag 'jigs gsum las phyi ma gnyis te/ de la rje sa skya pa chen pos rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang 'phros pa'i rgyud gnyis yin la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud ni 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud khri drug stong pa zhes bya ba yod la/ de'i le'u drug pa glur blangs pa'i le'u logs su phyung ba ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa 'di yin zhing*/ 'di nyid las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// ces pa las rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs// zhes pa las gdong drug gi rgyud dang*/ mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan// zhes pa las dgra nag gi rgyud rnams 'phros par bshad do// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung sgros las ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud ni gshin rje'i dgra nag po'i rgyud yin la/ bshad pa'i rgyud ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa dang gdong drug gi rgyud yin zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gshin rje dgra nag rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa'i skabs kyi 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa las sbyor gyi cha mi gsal ba rnams gsal bar byed pas gdong drug gi rgyud ni bshad rgyud du gtogs shing*/ 'di'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa dang*/ de wā ka ra tsan+d+ras lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdzad pa sogs la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i rim par brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las 'ongs pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed gdong pa drug pa lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba bsgrub par bgyi/

de la gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon ni/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes// cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas// snying rje'i slob ma rab 'dzin pa// dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /ces pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos par bshad/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma yang*/ dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul// rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan// sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba// mthun zhing grangs dang ldan pa gzung*// zhes pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma nang gshin pa gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar kha yar ba re dgos pa bshad/ gang gi tshe bskur ba'i dus ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas pa// yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na// mar ngo la yang nyes pa med// ces pa ste/ gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i yar ngo'am/ rab gnas kyi rgyud nas bstan pa'i gza' skar de dag lhag par 'dzom na mar ngo la'ang nyes pa med par bshad/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i gnas ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang mdor bstan las/ gang na sa phyogs chos ldan zhing*// gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa'i// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes pa ste/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos bskyangs shing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa/ khyad par rang ngam bla ma gong mas sa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du byas pa'i gnas su'o// gang la brten nas bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ mtshon par bya ba nges don don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni snying po bde ba chen po len pa'am 'dzin pa la bshad la/ de nyid mtshon par byed pa grangs don kun rdzob pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub chen so sos bkral ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag mang du gsungs kyang mdor bsdu na rdul tshon dang*/ ras bris dang*/ lus dkyil te gsum mam/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi las/

deng sang gi gang zag phal cher smin byed du rung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rdul tshon dang ras bris nyid gtso che bar gsungs/ gang zhig bskur ba dbang gi nges tshig ni/ a bhi ṣiñtsa'am a bhi ṣe ka ta zhes pa gtor ba dang blugs pa'i don te/ kye rdo rje las/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya 'dis// des na dbang zhes mngon par brjod// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang bzhi po rim pa bzhin du spyi bo dang*/ lce dang*/ dbang gi gnas dang rlung sems la gtor zhing blugs pas sku bzhi'i myu gu 'byung bas na dbang zhes bya ba yin/ ji ltar bskur ba dbang gi cho ga la/ lam la sbyor bar byed pa rgyu'i dbang*/ kun nas goms par byed pa lam gyi dbang*/ mi 'phrogs pa la sbyor bar byed pa 'bras bu'i dbang ste/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas gsum du nges kyang gang zag gi sgo nas du ma zhig 'gyur ba las/ 'dir smin byed kyi cho ga dang mthun par 'chad pa la/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun gyi sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i zhes sam/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i skabs su gang babs sbyar te/ 'dir sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la sa'i lha mo dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa lhag gnas gsum sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ da khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma sta gon la/ lus kyi bya ba maṇ+ḍal 'bul// bur bya spro bskyed bdun rnam dag /sdom gzung byin rlabs mchod pas mchod// so shing khyor chu ku sha sbyin// srung skud chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar chos bcu gsum yod pa las/ thog mar lus kyi bya ba khrus byas/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gus pa'i sgo nas 'khod du gzhug ces 'byung bas/ slob dpon la sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/

slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gnyis pa nang dbang bskur ba'am bur bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas khyed rnams skad cig gis gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud de khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig byung*/ slar sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'thon te rang rang gi gral la 'khod par mos/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i slad du thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa sogs nas/ skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// gshin rje sgrol ba'i grong khyer du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gsum pa gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa ni/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// dus gsum 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni// ye shes mnyam pa med pa brnyes// shākya seng ge sogs mchog gi /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// gang gi stobs kyis bdud kyi sde// shin tu mi bzad che bcom nas// 'jig rten rjes 'jug spyad nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces te/ de'i don ni/ khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas bur byas pa de la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te/ khyed rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa de khyed rnams la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yang nges pa'i don du bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas su zin yang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir/ slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'dzam bu'i gling du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ rtag par zhen pa rnams bzlog pa'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa yin/ de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba skal ba bzang ba yin pas khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa 'di las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ bzhi pa bdun rnam dag gi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor nas sprin phung 'thib pa ltar bzhugs par mos la/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun gyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar bstan pa'i don dam pa byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba ste don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa nas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ lnga pa sdom pa gzung ba ni/ yul de rnams kyi spyan sngar sdom pa gzung ba la/ sdom pa thams cad rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gnyis su 'du ba las/ spyi'i dam tshig ni gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du nyes spyod sdom pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can gyi don ci nus su sgrub par dam 'cha' ba 'jug pa sems bskyed pa rnams yin/ so so'i dam tshig ni/ rnam snang gi dam tshig tu phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa'o// mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i rdo rje dril bu/ phyag rgya/ slob dpon rnams 'dzin pa'o// rin 'byung gi dam tshig ni zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams pa'i sbyin pa rnams nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum te dus drug tu gtong ba'am/

dngos su mi nus na/ 'dun pa dang ma bral bar bya ba'o// 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig ni/ phyi bya spyod/ nang rnal 'byor/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhi dang*/ nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' ste theg pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin par dam 'cha' ba'o// don yod grub pa'i dam tshig ni/ sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya ba rnams so// de ltar nges par byas nas rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa rnams kyang gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs nas 'das la 'god/ de ltar byas pas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing*/ thob pa yar 'phel du byed la/ nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin no// drug pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du yas mar reg ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slar yang mas yar reg ste hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas gsal gdab pa dang*/ yas mar reg ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ des ni lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar byed pa yin/ bdun pa mchod pa bya ba ni/ de ltar khyed rnams kyi sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs ma thag pa de rgyal bu rgyal srid la dbang bskur bar kun gyis mchod yul du byed pa ltar mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ me tog dbu la phul te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+peḥ.āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ bdug spos shangs la dhū pe/

mar me spyan lam du ā lo ke dri'i byug pa thugs kar gan+dhe/ zhal zas ljags la phul te/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa ni sgo gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don yin/ brgyad pa dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ so shing sbyin pa ni/ so shing las bum gyi chu dang sngags kyi bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa de khyed rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du/ oṃ āḥdzi hwā badz+ra saṃ war+dha ni swā hā/ zhes pas byin pa'i so shing de rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te/ so'i rtsa bar drud pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas brgyud de khong par song bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos te/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa haṃ zhes brjod cing maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa bkod pa'i dbus su 'dor ba zhu/ de ltar dor bas rtse mo shar du bstan na zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ mtshams rnams su dngos grub phran tshegs 'grub par 'gyur ro// dgu pa rmi lam gsal po 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las byung ba'i khyor chu ngag gi dri ma sbyang ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ waṃ zhes lan bdun bzlas pa/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ nish+tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalbān a pa na ya hūm̐/

zhes pas lan gsum du sbyin/ bcu pa rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥdang hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas kyi don du/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa dhīḥzhes pas lag pa g.yas dang*/ che ba stan gyi don du oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa hūm̐ zhes pas g.yon du byin te/ de'i don ni sngon byung bcom ldan 'das ku sha ma 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ 'dir yang ku sha'i stan la nyal te chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa'o// bcu gcig pa rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir srung skud 'dogs pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril byas par rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi bar chad srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi lha'i

sta gon gnyis pa man nas mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka zhes brjod/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig gi srad bur thim par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rī sogs lan bdun du bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su nyis skor du/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbān swā hā zhes brjod cing bcings nas las bum gyi chus gtor te bsrung ngo*// bcu gnyis pa chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de'i don ni 'jig rten na u dum+bā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dkon zhes sogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas don de dag la dga' ba khyad par can bskyed par mdzod cig /ces pa'i bar spyi ltar brjod pa'am/ yang na/ dkon zhes pa'i rjes thogs su/ byon nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ gsungs pa'i bstan pa gnas pa dang*/ bstan pa'i rjes su bdag gzhan 'jug pa yod pa rnams dkon zhing*/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba ni shin tu dkon no// dkon pa tsam du ma zad/ phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbang blangs nas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsrung bsdam tshul bzhin du bgyi zhing*/ lam la ci nus kyis 'dun pa byas na brtson 'grus dang bstun pa'i bye brag gis/ tshe 'di'am bar do'am/ skye ba bdun nam/ bcu drug tshun chad du 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur ba gdon mi za bar de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa las 'byung ba'i phyir/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu la nye zhing*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/

skye ba phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa rtsol sgrub logs shig mi dgos par zhar byung gi tshul gyis 'grub pa yin no// des na rnyed par dka' la phan yon che ba'i gsang sngags kyi theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ngo snyam du shes pa'i sgo nas lam 'di la dga' ba khyad par can bskyed par mdzod cig ces pa'i don yin/ zhes pa de gnyis gang rung re brjod/ bcu gsum pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun nga la drang por smros// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'am rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i mal bcas par sngar byin pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du bting*/ gos dri ma med pa gyon/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis mgo dkyil 'khor la phyogs par nyal te/ sems dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thag ring du byas/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbazla zhing sang nyin yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i ngang nas nyal na lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de'ang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam thogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su zhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma dang mjal ba/ nyi zla shar ba/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ khrus byas pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ chu las brgal ba/ mtshon cha rnyed pa rnams rmi na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gang yang rung ba 'grub par shes par byas nas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te ngan pa'ang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyes kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ ka ra wi ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/

spre'u dang bong bu la zhon te kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mo dang ma he la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ 'dam du bying ba/ dong du lhung ba/ ri rtse nas lhung ba/ ljon shing chag pa la sogs pa rmis na cung zad ngan pa yin pas/ gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de/ bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam pa'i spros bral gyi sbyang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs snying po bzlas pas bsrung ba dang*/ zhi ba'i sreg blugs bya ba'i sgo nas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya dgos so// de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags/ zhes brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang zhing de kho na nyid bden pa bsgrags pa'i bar grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ slob ma bos nas sta gon gyi gral rim ltar 'khod pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa rnams rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la rang re rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re bya dgos te/

de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ kye rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na'ang*/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi dri ma sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal gyi khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing*/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang*/ mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa yin/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can de rnams kyi pha mar ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ pha mar byas res kyi gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing*/ phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin chen 'di rnams sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag pa'i slad du/ tshe 'di'i bya ba snying po med pa thams cad spangs nas dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang shes rab chen po zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum mtha' rten dang bcas pa blangs la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ de la 'dir gdul bya zhe sdang can rjes su 'dzin par byed pa ni/ ji skad du/

don dam chos sku zhi ba nyid// gang 'dir khams gsum rnam rgyal te// gshin rje'i dgra zhes grags pa yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor gyi nang tshan bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma ste/ de la'ang bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma btang ba/ nang du log ste 'dud bstod bya ba bcas dgos na'ang de dag legs par grub par byas pa'o// 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ slob dpon rang nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du len pa dang*/ de'i rjes su yi dam chos skyong gtor mas mnyes par bya ba rnams dgos na'ang de rnams kyang sngon du legs par grub nas/ da khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas dbang bzhi bskur ba gnyis las/ dang por 'jug pa la/ khrus byas maṇ+ḍal bgegs bskrad bya// mig dar me tog gtad gsol gdab// rgyun bshags sdom gzung byin gyis brlab// nang gi sems bskyed gsang bar gdams// dris lan byas te nang du 'khrid// phyag 'tshal dam bzhag ye shes dbab// gsol gdab ltas brtag me tog dor// gdong dbye dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o// zhes pa ltar chos nyer gcig las/ thog mar las bum gyi chus khyed rnams kyi kha la sogs pa dag par byas nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gral rim ltar 'khod cing*/ slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed gdong drug pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chus khyed rnams la gtor te lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bgegs dang dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par mos/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bgegs bskrad de/ sngon chad gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mig dar dmar po res gdong bcings te/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wā ra ma nā ya hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bcings nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas phyag rten gyi slad du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i me tog gi phreng ba re yang byin te/ u dum+bā ra man+da ra// yongs 'du dang ni mā li ka /kar+ṇi ka yi phreng ba 'di// legs par nos te bu khyod zung*// ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas gtad de/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ e ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ bdun rnam dag gi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du/ khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la nas 'grub par shog gi bar gyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ slar yang rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs nas mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ gzung bya dam tshig dang sdom pa'i gtso bo ni dbang bskur ba las skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas gnas gsum yas mar du reg pa rnams ni sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas nas/ gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis sa ma ya a/ zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig lam gyis byung bar mos/

de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig gsal btab ste/ de lta bu'i bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā dā ya mi/ zhes pas thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par byas nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun du spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa rnams la ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ 'gyur ta re zhes gsang bar gdams nas/ rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis/ kye bu sdug pa khyod su yin/ zhes dris pa'i lan 'debs par mos pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa bdag lags so// 'dun pa nges pa'i slad du/ ci la dga' zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde ba chen po la'o// de ci'i phyir nges par bya ba ni/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes pas lan bya/ de rnams phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang 'jug gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sgo ba bzhi spros pas khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par mos te/ khyed rnams gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su dbu 'dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas yol ba'i nang du khrid par mos/ de nas sgo ba bzhi'i zhal nas oṃ badz+rod+gha ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas gzhal yas khang gi sgo bzhi phye bar bsam/

khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas sku gsung thugs la phyag bya ba'i mos pas thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ na ma te hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ slar yang zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo snying gar sbyar te byin gyis brlabs par gsol ba'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pas+tha nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes pas gtso bo la'o// yang gnas de nyid nas gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyi thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ byin gyis brlab par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pas+tha na ya ta thā ga tā āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes pas gti mug gshin rje'i gshed la'o// de nas g.yas skor gyis phyin te/ lho sgo nas phra ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo dpral bar sbyar nas/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes pas ser sna gshin rje'i gshed la'o// nub sgo nas 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo mgrin par sbyar te chos ston par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra war+t+ta nā ya āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma tsakra pra war+t+ta nā ya māṃ/ zhes pas 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed la'o// byang sgo nas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ phrin las bsgrub par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇi āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes pas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed rnams la phyag byas nas/

ye shes dbab pa'i sngon 'gro dam bzhag bzhi las/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ de ring khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs nas/ nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzung ste/ gshin rje gshed po nas gshegs zhes dang*/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum chu blud cing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi nas u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ dam tshig rdo rje'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje dang*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje nas/ 'gems par byed do// bla ma'i bka' mnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bo dang*/ deng phyin chad bu khyod nas/ ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pas dam la bzhag pa rnams song nas/ nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab par zhu ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams lus tsog pur 'dug ste/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis la/ de'i ngang nas khyed rang rnams dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad nas gnas pa'i rkang pa'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ rkang mthil du dzhaiṃ dmar po/ snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin pa chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po waṃ gyis mtshan pa/ spyi bor gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams bkra lam gyis yod par mos/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rkang zhabs kyi rlung la phog pas/ rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar ba rkang pa'i nang nas gyen du song bas/ snying ga'i sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/

mgrin pa'i chu bkol/ spyi gtsug gi lha tshogs rnams lus la thim/ me'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis bdug cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥ'i mthar/ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ zhes yang yang brjod cing dbab/ de ltar ye shes phab pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan pa'i phyir/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas nas/ de'ang sku babs na 'phar g.yo dang*/ gsung babs na smra dgod dang*/ thugs babs na dus gsum shes pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de'i tshe slob ma'i lce la a bsgoms la/ rdo rje chos ni mgon po che// snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che// smros shig 'dod chags chos chen po// rdo rje dge dang mi dge smros// zhes brjod pas legs nyes thams cad smra bar 'gyur ro// de ltar ye shes phab pa'i slob ma lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprad pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor la gsol ba 'debs pa slob dpon gyis bgyi dgos pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas de bzhin shog ces gsol ba btab nas/ dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ khyed rnams mig mig ras dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la gzigs pas kha dog gang snang ba cig nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na ci snang zhes dri/ de'ang dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po'am nag po drag po/ sna tshogs kyis las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar ltas brtags nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod pa ni/

zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod do// de nas dkyil 'khor la me tog 'bul ba ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed zhal drug pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhugs te/ de'ang dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes yang dag pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa ma gtogs ngo bo la bzang ngan nam mchog dman gyi khyad par med kyang*/ rang gi las bsags pa'i lha zhig la bab par shog shig snyam pas sngar gyi me tog de/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes gsung zhing 'bul mdzod cig de ltar phul ba'i me tog de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phog na thugs/ shar du sku/ lhor yon tan/ nub tu gsung*/ byang du phrin las/ bar du lhung na gang nye ba/ mnyam na gnyi ga sku stod la phog na mchog rked par 'bring*/ sku smad la phog na tha ma/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du lhung na yang bskyar te dor ro// slar yang me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ zhes brjod/ khyed rnams kyi mig 'bras gnyis su oṃ dkar po re sgoms shig oṃ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi sogs nas laṃ hrīḥzhes pas ma rig pa'i ling tog dang mig ras lhan cig bsal nas/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas snyam du mos pa mdzod/ dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba ni/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyed kyi rigs kyi lha// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// he badz+ra pa sh+yaḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul nas/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed lha nyer gcig gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos 'byung gi nang du chud pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa sogs nas rgyas bsdus gang rigs brjod/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ shar dang mtshams dang grwa rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ lho dang nub dang byang dang sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa dang*/ brten pa lha ni dbus su ma he nag po dregs pa dang bcas shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rwa dang rmig pa rno ba/ lce glog ltar 'gyu ba'i steng du/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug sogs nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna rdo rje sogs nas bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar rgyas pa'am/ mi nus na/ zhabs drug pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ shar du gti mug rdo rje dkar po sogs lhor ser sna rdo rje ser po sogs nas dri chab ma ljang gu rnams ni brten pa lha ste/ mdor na bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug ldan 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du mthong snyam pa'i dga' spro dang bcas te bla ma'i zhabs la phyag bya ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas hoḥzhes brjod/

de rnams kyis lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis las/ dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ji ltar rdo rje 'chang nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bgegs bsal ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus gtor zhing nyungs kar gyis brab pa dang bcas te/ khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs bsal lo// de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod cing gsol ba gdab dgos pas/ de'ang 'di lta ste/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ rdo rje 'chang gis 'gro skyabs nas stsal du gsol/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal nas kyang*/ bu de rnams dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin na dbang bskur cig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// dkyus su ma byung yang*/ skabs 'dir las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal dang las bum bteg nas bzung*/ slob dpon gyis me tog char 'bebs shing dril bu 'khrol ba dang bcas te/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyi shis pa brjod na shin tu legs pa sems/ dbang bskur ba dngos la/ chu dang cod paṇa rdo dril ming*// zhes pa'i lnga las/ dang por mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang la nang dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje nas mdzod cig ces gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chus bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/

khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī dang gnyis su med pa mnyam par sbyor ba/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo yab yum du gnas pa'i zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar 'thon pa hūm̐ las rdo rje tho ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal nag po sogs nas klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang sogs nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas yum gyi mkhar khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig tu byung bar mos pa mdzod/ de gnyis yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 'thon/ khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod/ dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu ba rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ rig ma brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu/ sgo ba bzhi/ sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ phyi'i dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje nas rdo rje'i deng bdag stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs/ yum bzhis bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i nas/ bum pa'i dbang mchog blang bar mdzod// zhes dbang bskur bar gdams nas/ slob dpon gyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing*/ bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po nas s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can ma lus rang bzhin kun gyi mchog gyur pa// skyed byed kyis bskyed bde ba thams cad 'byung ba ji lta ba// de ltar dbang bskur mchog gis 'dir ni bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra had/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ badz+ra dharma gā ya ni/ badz+ra karma ka rod+bha be/ zhes rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥbi gh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod de dbang bskur/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las khyed rnams kyi spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang bskur gyi lha rnams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas khyed rnams la thim pas/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar mi bskyod pa/ spyi bor rnam snang*/ mgrin par snang ba mtha' yas/ lte bar rin 'byung*/ gsang gnas su don grub/ sa'i khams la mā ma kī/ me'i khams la gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams la dam tshig sgrol ma/ mig tu sa snying*/ rna bar phyag rdor/ snar nam snying*/ lcer spyan ras gzigs/ dpral bar sgrib sel/

snying gar kun bzang*/ phyag sor bcu la khro bo bcu/ zhabs sor bcu la khro mo bcu/ yan lag bzhi la sgo ba bzhi/ mkha' 'gro pho mo ba spu'i tshogs la thim pas phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin gtso bo yab yum gyi skur gyur/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa gyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wid+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi sgrib pa dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyis dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du slob dpon ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan yon tan sogs nas/ yon tan rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ dbu rgyan bh+rūm̐ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las rnam snang la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang*/ khyed rnams aṃ las rin po che aṃ gyis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma dang gnyis su med pa mnyam par sbyor ba/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar 'thon/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gong ltar bskyed cing*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas/ yum gyi mkhar khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim par mos pa mdzod/ de gnyis yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 'thon/

khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lhor 'khod/ dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu ba rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rin chen 'byung ldan gyis gtso byas pa spyan drangs pa la mchod/ phyi'i dbang gi don du byang chub rdo rje sogs gsum gyi mthar/ rin chen rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan nas// dbu rgyan dbang mchog blang bar mdzod// ces gdams nas/ dbang bskur gyi lha slob dpon lhan cig pas dbu rgyan khyed rnams kyi spyi bor cod paṇa bcing zhing*/ dbu rgyan dbang bskur chen po nas a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ su ra ti s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las khyed rnams kyi spyi bor rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par mos/ dbang bskur gyi lha rnams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas de rnams phung khams skye mched so sor thim pas khyed rnams ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gyur/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs dang*/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob sogs rtogs bskyed brjod/ 'di man chad des rigs 'gre sbyar te/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du slob dpon 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan gsung gi nas gsung gi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig ces gsol ba gdab/ khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas rdo rje bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gos dkar mo dmar mo dang gnyis su med pa mnyam par sbyor ba/

slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar 'thon/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar po dang gnyis su med par bskyed cing*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim/ de gnyis yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon te dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu 'khod/ dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur pa dang*/ dbang lha 'od dpag med kyis gtso byas pa spyan drangs pa la mchod pa rnams 'dra/ phyi'i dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rje sogs gsum gyis mthar/ pad+ma'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i nas/ rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// zhes dang*/ lag pa g.yas su rdo rje gtad la/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur nas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang lha gong ltar bstim pas/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du gyur/ de la mchod/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob sogs rtogs bskyed bya/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du/ slob dpon phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan phrin las rdo rje nas/ phrin las rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces pas gsol ba gdab/ khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang gnyis su med pa mnyam par sbyor ba/

slob dpon gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma dang gnyis su med par bskyed cing*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dbu gtsug nas zhugs te bstim/ de gnyis yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon te dkyil 'khor gyi byang du 'khod/ dbang rdzas dril bur gyur pa dang*/ dbang lha don yod grub pas gtso byas spyan drangs pa la mchod pa rnams 'dra/ phyi'i dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rje nas/ ral gri'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang nas/ dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// zhes dang*/ lag pa g.yon par dril bu gtad la/ dril bu'i dbang bskur chen po nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur sogs nas/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang lha bstim pas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa la mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob sogs rtogs bskyed bya'o// rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du/ slob dpon gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'chang nas/ sku yi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ khyed rnams stong pa'i ngang las buṃ las 'khor lo buṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang gnyis su med pa mnyam par sbyor ba/ slob dpon gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang gnyis su med par bskyed cing*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/

dbu gtsug nas zhugs te bstim/ de yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 'thon/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'khod/ dbang lha rnam snang gis gtso byas pa spyan drangs pa la mchod/ phyi'i dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rje sogs gsum gyi mthar/ 'khor lo'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang nas/ rdo rje'i ming dbang khyod kyis longs// zhes gdams nas rdo rje dril bu spyi bor dkrol ba dang bcas te/ ming gi dbang bskur chen po mchog /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang ba gsum ni 'byung ba'i gnas// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ kye dpal zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs pa me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i rigs las dras te ming gi dbang bskur/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang lha phung khams skye mched so sor bstim pas/ khyed rnams gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa la mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob sogs brjod do// brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du khyed rnams skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ 'di la nang dbang bskur ba med pas/ dbang gi lha slob dpon dang lhan cig pas/ 'di de sangs rgyas nas/ badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing byin pa'i rdo rje de gsor te snying gar bzung nas/ snying ga'i nang du'ang rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum de 'dra ba zhig gi rgyas gdab par bsgom pa rnams ni/ ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga dang*/ phung po lnga sbyangs nas/

rig pa ye shes lnga dang sku lngar byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga ste/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje slob ma'i las thams cad la dbang bar byas pa'o// gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhi las/ dang po slob dpon rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum du mos la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kye ho khyed kyi nas stobs dang ldan pa byin zhes thun mong dang*/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur sogs nas/ rtag tu slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsungs// zhes thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ de nyid slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa khyed rnams rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu'i gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas/ khyed rnams yum gyi mkhar rdo rje 'chang yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim par slob dpon du dbang bskur ba dang*/ ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig tu byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slar yang yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 'thon te/

gzhal yas khang gi dbus su dbang stegs seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'khod pa la/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad sprin ltar gtibs pa'i dbus su gnas par mos te/ phyi dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas dam tshig gsum rim pa bzhin sbyin dgos pa las/ thog mar rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi don du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje khyed rnams kyi phyag tu byin te/ 'di de sangs rgyas sogs nas hi hi hūm̐/ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de snying gar gsor te bzung nas/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la thugs gtad mdzod/ thog mtha' nas/ bdag po'i tshul/ de'i don ni rdo rje 'di ni thog ma dang tha ma bral ba'i byang chub kyi sems rig stong dbyer med mtshon par byed pa/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu zung zhig ces pa'o// dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi don du aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu phyag g.yon du byin te/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nas/ ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas byin pa'i dril bu de 'khrol te dku g.yon par bzung nas dril bu'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la thugs gtad mdzod/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid nas/ mchog tu byed/ de'i don ni dril bu 'di ni srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag par ston par byed pa/ grag stong dbyer med gsung gi dam tshig tu zung zhig ces pa'o// phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi slad du/ khyed rnams rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol te 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas la/ yum kun tu bzang mo dang snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen pos lus thams cad du khyab par mos la/ rdo rje che dang nas bsdu bar gyis zhes pas byin la/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la thugs gtad mdzod/

srid pa'i bde ba nas brtan phyir ro// de'i don ni phyag rgya 'di ni snang stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo sku'i dam tshig tu shes par gyis la zung zhig ces pa'o// de ltar na dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig ces pa'i don to// slar yang slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi byang chub sems dpa' brgyad lha mo drug sogs gong ltar spyan drangs nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs/ yum bzhi dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa thogs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa māṃ/ su ra te sa ma ye s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis gang zhig brjod pa sogs nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gong mi bskyod pa'i chu dbang gi dus ltar brjod la/ dbang bskur gyi lha rnams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi phung khams skye mched so sor thim pas khyed rnams kyi snying gar mi bskyod pa sogs nas/ mkha' 'gro pho mo ba spu'i tshogs la thim pas phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur gyur/ de la nye bar spyod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa gyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de nyid la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par mos/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba yin no// de nas de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor dang lha de dag gi rnam dag bstan pa ni/

gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs nas sgo ba bzhi'o// zhes gzhal yas khang dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan te/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba yin no// de ltar rnam dag rtogs pa'i slob ma la mtha' rten rjes su gnang ba rnams rim bzhin sbyin dgos pas/ de la/ sku dang sngags dang phyag mtshan dang*// dbyug tho ral gri mda' gzhu mchod// mig sman me long phrin las bzhi// grub chen gzhan don chos bshad do// zhes pa ltar bcu gsum las/ dang por khro bo'i rgyal po gdong pa drug pa'i sku byin te/ nyin re bzhin nas/ yi dam sgrubs zhes pa ste/ deng nas brtsams te nyin re bzhin du thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i sgo nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gang 'dod pa sgrubs shig ces pa'i don yin/ gnyis pa sngags bzlas lung gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po gsal btab ste/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas 'thon te khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod par mos te sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum brjod pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs lan gsum/ de nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor me tog bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs zhes brjod pa ni/ lhas slob ma rjes su gzung ba dang*/ khyed rnams kyis me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la nas gsol zhes brjod pa ni slob mas lha yi dam du gzung ba'o// gsum pa phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang la/ khyed rnams gshin rje'i gshed zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas su tho ba/

ral gri/ rdo rje/ g.yon du zhags pa/ gtun shing*/ dril bu rnams byin te/ rdo rje tho ba sogs nas bslang bar gyis/ zhes pas phyag mtshan rnams byin nas/ bzhi pa dbyug tho'i rjes gnang ni/ dbyug pa skad cig tsam gyis dbyug pa gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba dbyug to'i rnam par gyur pa phyag g.yas su byin te/ rdo rje thod dbyug sogs nas badz+ra daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ zhes pa ste/ de ni bdud dang gshin rjer snang ba'i rtog pa thams cad gzhom pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// lnga pa ral gri'i rjes gnang ni/ ral gri skad cig tsam gyis ral gri gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba ral gri'i rnam par gyur pa phyag g.yas su byin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri nas khaḍ+ga hoḥzhes pas byin te/ da ni shes rab kyi ral gris spang bya ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang lta ba ngan pa'i drwa ba gcod pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// drug pa mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ni/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan yang thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang bral na nyan rang gi sar ltung bar 'gyur bas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom dgos so zhes pa'i ched du hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu byin pa de phyogs bzhir 'phen pa'i tshul re mdzod cig chos rnams thabs dang shes rab nas/ a nu ra gā ya mi zhes pas byin te/ de ni thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// bdun pa mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ sdug pa'i gdong du bltas nas/ gzi can 'gyur zhes pa ste/ de ni 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten pa thams cad kyang lha'i rnal 'byor gyis zhen med du longs spyad de bde stong zung 'jug gi mchod pas sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa'i bsam pas zin par gyis shig ces pa'i don to// brgyad pa mig thur gyi rjes gnang ni/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin gser gyi mig thur gyis/ khyed rnams kyi mig gi sgrib byed praṃ nag po gnas pa bsal nas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar mig mkhan nas bsal zhes so// dgu pa me long spyan gyi thad kar bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan nas badz+ra ā dar+sha hoḥzhes pa ste/ de ni chos can gyi snang ba thams cad snang la rang bzhin med par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// bcu pa sna tshogs rdo rje byin te/ zhi ba'i sems nas dbab par gyis zhes pa ste/ de ni zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// bcu gcig pa dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ tshig 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ ral gri mig sman nas sgrub par gyis zhes pa ste/ de ni ral gri khar bzung nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ mig la mig sman byugs nas 'jig rten gsum mthong ba dang*/ sa 'og gi gter gyi bum pa bton nas ci 'dod dngos grub ster ba dang*/ rkang pa la rdzas byugs nas myur du bgrod pa rkang mgyogs dang*/ ril bu khar bcug nas sus kyang mi snang zhing gnod sbyin ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs su bsgyur ba dang*/ dpral bar thig le bkod nas bdag sus kyang mi mthong ba dang*/ tshe nyi zla ltar gnas pa dang*/ lus lo bcu drug lon pa 'dra ba dang*/ lcags dang zangs gser du bsgyur ba ste gsum ni bcud len zhes bya ste/ tshe dang lus dang longs spyod kyi bcud len dang*/ bu mo dam pa dgug pa ni gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa ste/ dngos grub brgyad sgrub pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don gyis shig ces rjes su gnang ba dang*/ bcu gnyis pa/ sems can gyi don bya ba de'ang nyon mongs pa dug lnga gang dang gang gis nyen par gyur pa de dang de'i gnyen por shes pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/

zhe sdang gis mnan nas/ phrag dog thams cad zad par gyis zhes so// bcu gsum pa chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ zhes pas rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo byin te sems can 'khor ba las drongs shig ces dang*/ 'dren lugs ji ltar na/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas phyag g.yas su dung byin te dung bus la sems can rnams 'khor du sdus shig ces dang*/ tshul ji ltar na/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas g.yon du dril bu byin te chos kyi sgra sgrogs shig ces dang*/ chos gang gis na/ dharma a/ zhes pas dpung par pusti byin te chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs shig ces pa rnams kyi don du/ deng nas brtsams te nas srung bar mdzad ces so// chos bshad pa de'ang*/ gnas skabs su gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par theg pa gsum gang la gang 'dul ston dgos kyang*/ mthar thug de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rdo rje'i theg pa ston dgos so zhes shes pa'i don du/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba la/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya rnams kyang mdzad pa zhu/ 'jig rten khams ni nas rab tu bskor zhes pa ste/ de ni khyed rnams kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo// rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor la/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces pa'i don to// de ltar na rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin skabs dang sbyar te dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob sogs nas/ sprul sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// de rnams kyis bum dbang 'khor bcas song nas/ gsang dbang sogs gsum ga la/ yon dbul gsol gdab mig dar bcing*// dbang dngos bskur la mtha' rten sbyin// zhes pa ltar lnga lnga las/ thog mar gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/

de ltar phul nas/ gsang dbang gi rten mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya 'bul ba dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs nas/ gsang ba'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig dar rnams bcing ba zhu/ bsrung ba'i phyir nang mchod kyi bdud rtsis khyed rnams la gtor te byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas bla ma gshin rje gshed yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang*/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rnams kyi ljags thog tu byin te/ btung ba rin po che 'di nas/ yid las byung ba'i chu 'di 'thung*// zhes gsung zhing byin pa'i bdud rtsi de/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ zhes brjod cing myang bar zhu/ de ltar myang bas mgrin pa na gzhir gnas kyi ya ra la wa zhes pa'i yi ge byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis byin pa'i byang chub kyi sems gdan gsum tshang ba de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres pas snang mched thob gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rags pa rnams 'gags nas stong pa dang shin tu stong pa dang*/ stong pa chen po'i stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skyes nas/ ngag gi dri ma dag 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/

de'i mtha' rten du lung bstan pa ni/ lung phal cher sprul sku rab tu byung bas ston srid pas/ skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du bsgyur nas/ lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags bag phab pa'i rna ba ltar 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor gtugs nas/ rang rang gi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mos pa mdzod/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan sogs nas/ rnams las bton/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhur+bhu wa swaḥ/ ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis lung bstan par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di la dad par gyis shig ces lung bstan pas de ltar 'gyur nges snyam pa'i dga' ba bskyed mdzod/ de ltar na zhes sogs kyis rtogs bskyed bya/ de rnams kyis gsang dbang song nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang gis 'gro bskyab phyir nas/ shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bcings/ bdud rtsis byin gyis brlabs/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas phyag rgya dung can/ pad+ma can la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i yid du 'ong ba lang tsho la bab pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig sprul te/ slob dpon gyis phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung ste/ khyed rnams kyi lag g.yon du gtad la/ khyer cig khyer cig nas/ mchod pa dag tu gyis/ zhes pas byin pa'i phyag rgya nges khyed rnams gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa'i snod dang ldan mi ldan brtag pa'i phyir dri ba byas par mos/

dri chen dri chu la sogs nas/ bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci// khyed rnams kyis ji ltar dris pa de ltar spro bar lan gdab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dri chen sogs nas lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro/ zhes lan btab par phyag rgya de dgyes pas dri zhim pos bsgos pa'i pad+ma bstan te/ e ma nga yi pad+ma nas/ mok+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod de pang du byon par bsam/ de nas khyed rnams gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa dang*/ phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs mar mngon par rtogs pa ltar lhar bskyed/ gnyis ka'i sku gsung thugs dang skye mched kyi lha rnams kyang mngon rtogs ltar bkod/ de'ang yab kyi sku gsung thugs skye mched kyi lha rnams pho dang*/ yum gyi lha rnams lha mo'i rnam pa can du gyur ces brjod/ yab yum gnyis ka'i mkha' gsang byin rlabs dkyus ltar bya/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar haṃ mgo thur du blta ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ mgo gyen du blta ba/ snying gar chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mgo thur du blta ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar aṃ mgo gyen du blta ba/ gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar phaṭa dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ khyed rnams gshin rje'i gshed yab yum phan tshun spyan zur gyis blta res byas pas mig sa'i snying po yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ rna ba phan tshun dga' ba'i gtam dang bstod pa dang bsngags tshig brjod pas rna ba phyag rdor yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ yab yum gyi lus la gur gum tsan+dan ga pur la sogs pa'i dri bzang pos byugs te snom res byas pas sna nam mkha'i snying po yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ bu ram dang sbrang rtsi dang li kha ra sbren ma dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa yum gyi lces blangs la yab kyi zhal du 'bul ba/

yab kyi lces blangs te yum gyi zhal du phul ba sogs byas pas/ lce spyan ras gzigs yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ 'khyud pa dang 'o byed pa dang*/ nu ma nyed pa dang*/ mkhal khung 'tshir ba dang*/ sen mos 'debs pa dang*/ nor bu khas 'dzin pa dang*/ bha gar 'o byed pa la sogs pas ni/ lus sgrib pa rnams sel yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ snying ga gnyis sprad pa ni yid kun tu bzang po yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ dpral bar sbyar bas sku rdo rje yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ mgrin pa sbyar bas gsung rdo rje yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ snying ga sbyar bas thugs rdo rje yab yum sbyor bas mnyes par byas par bsam/ de ltar rang dang phyag rgya lha'i skur gsal ba sprul sku lam du byed pa lha'i 'du shes/ sgra ha ha si si kun du ru badz+ra dhṛka ces pa'i sgra grag pa ni longs sku lam du byed pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ 'khor lo la sems gzung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod par bya'o snyam pa ni chos sku lam du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes khams dwangs ma rnams zhu nas spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus te/ haṃ las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun rtsa dbu ma'i nang

cho ga 'di'i dkyus su 'dir lte ba'i aṃ las me sbar/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bsregs nas spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems 'bab par bshad kyang*/ 'dir rjes chags kyi mes bzhu ba las/ gtum mo'i mes bzhu dgos pa mi sems te/ rwa chen gyi 'jigs byed dbang chur yang de ltar ma bshad pa'i phyir 'di tsam gyis thus par sems so// nas babs te mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ gsang gnas su byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes bde ba la mi rtog pa'i brgyan pa'i ngang du bskyangs pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag nas zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar 'bru gsum gyis mig ras 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i nas/ nam yang ma byed cig ces pa ste/ de ni dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa zhes bya ba 'di gsum dang bral na sdig che ba yin par/ de gsum dang ma bral bar gyis shig ces pa'i don to// de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du sogs nas/ chos sku thob rang gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang song nas/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin nas/ bka' drin rgyas ni bskyab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ gdong g.yogs 'ching ba dang byin gyis brlabs nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprod pa ni/ rgyal mtshan can gyi khyams mthong nas// der ni 'o ma rab bsgrub bya// 'o ma las sems gcig goms nas// phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub 'gyur// zhes pa ste/
