de'i don ni/ rgyal mtshan ni thabs kyi rdo rje/ de dang ldan pa'i khyams ni shes rab kyi mkha'/ der 'o ma bsgrub par bya ba ni/ 'du shes sum ldan gyi sgo nas der snyoms par 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dbab pa dang*/ gzung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ lus thams cad du khyab par bkram pas zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char la/ de la sems rtse gcig tu sgoms pa las skyes pas rang bzhin lhan skyes/ bde gsal mi rtog pa ni/ ye shes phyag rgya chen po ste/ de nyid rab tu bsgrub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i don te/ rgyud sde rnams las/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes mtshon bya mtshon byed du gsungs pa'i don/ mtshon bya don gyi dbang bzhi pa yang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de nyid dbang gsum pa'i ye shes 'dis mtshon nus pa yin no// zhes ngo sprod pa ni/ tshig gi bzhi pa ste/ ji ltar mtshon na/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ de'i sems rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba/ bde ba'i ngo bo la bltas pa na/ phyi rol pas brtags pa'i bdag dang*/ nyan thos sde gnyis kyis brtags pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi chos dang gzung 'dzin gnyis rnam par spangs pa rnam rig pa'i gnyis med kyi shes pa'i bar gyi/ rnam par rtog pa gang yang ma grub pa'i nam mkha' lta bu yin la/ de'ang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad pas na des mtshon nus pas so// ye shes de nyid las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mthar phyin te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yan lag bdun ldan mngon du gyis shig ces pa ni lam gyi bzhi pa'o// zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa la lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan par byas nas/

chos thams cad rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin du gnas pa de nyid 'bras bu'i dus kyi sku bzhi dang ngo bo dbyer med du nges pa nas/ khyad par dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par gsal la ma 'gags par snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba bde ba chen po'i rnam par shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ de'i rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid ni chos kyi sku ste/ de gsum ldog tshul tha dad kyang so sor dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku rnams tha mi dad pa'i rang bzhin skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu ste/ nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ro gcig pa ltar/ sems dang bde stong ro gcig pa de'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de dbang bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du gzengs bstod pa ni/ deng tshe bdag ni 'bras bur nas/ de ring sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// zhes pa ste/ snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir khyed rnams btsud cing mthong ba la brten nas/ phyin chad sdig pa dang sdug bsngal las grol te/ bde ba chen po 'bras bu'i theg pa 'dir tshud pas/ gson pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes pas lam 'di la dga' ba khyad par can bskyed cig de ltar byas na srid pa shin tu dag pa sku bzhi'i 'byor pa thob pa sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung ba yin no// de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du sogs nas/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// de rnams kyis dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal du 'bul ba ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul gyi/ bzhes la cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te nas/ spyad du gsol/ de rnams kyis dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams la brten nas/ mkhas shing grub pa'i slob dpon chen po klu'i byang chub dang*/ de wā ka ra tsan+d+ra sogs kyis bkral ba dpal gshin rje gshed gdong pa drug pa lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba brgyud pa'i rim pa bar ma chad pa las/ ji ltar byung ba kho bos legs par thob pa khyed rnams la phul ba yin pas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas btab nas/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// slob dpon gyi rjes kyi cho ga rnams rdul tshon nam ras bris gang gi skabs su bab pa ltar byas te/ bkra shis dang bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan te/ ci bder gnas par bya'o// smras pa/ dus dgra'i rgyud lung rin chen dbang gi rgyal// 'grel byed mkhas pa'i 'chos skyob gos lhub rtser// rnam par bkod la skal dman dogs pa bskyungs// legs bshad mkhas tshul ngom pa'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar// shin tu gsal byas 'brel med smra ba'i mtshang*// bdag mdun slob ma'i khyad par bsgyur 'os kyang*// gzhung don rtogs dkar gyur pa'i tshig don cha// dpyod ldan slob mar dgos pa'i bsgom byar bcas// 'di sbyar dge ba'i biṣ+ṇu'i 'jug pa yis// kha khral 'khyog por bgrod pa'i lus bcad kyang*// rgyud gsum rten 'brel mkhas pa'i shugs stobs kyis// gsang rgyud bstan pa'i gser ldan 'degs phyir bsngo// zhes bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa lha nyer gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor smin byed gser ldan 'degs pa'i 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dpal sa skya pa'i phrin las kyi zla snang 'gyed pa'i chos rje bud+dha bha dra pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ mkhas grub rgya ston gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog dang*/ rwa lo tsā ba chen po badz+ra kīrtis mdzad pa'i dbang chu la sogs pa'i dgongs don gyi snying po nyams su blang bde bar/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung la sbyangs pa'i btags ming du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bgyi bas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing sprel gyi gnam lo shar bar/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags pa'i mu khyud kyis bsrungs pa'i phyogs kyi bsti gnas ga la bar sug bris su bgyis pa shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tāṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
